headline: Wardens Complete Sweep of Callahan's Passage; Nevish Line Erupts Anew
war_summary: The map has shifted again in the hours since our last edition. Callahan's Passage is now wholly Warden-held, its tenth post fallen, though the guns there have gone quiet in the past two hours after twenty-nine recorded actions in the day. The Nevish Line, quiet at midday, has rekindled hard: Colonial holdings are cut to a single post with two more demolished, Blinding Stones, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother all figuring in the ledger, and the newest entry is stamped at press time itself. Kuura Strand has newly erupted—eight actions inside two hours about Martti and Menneen, six Warden flags still standing even as posts changed hands and changed back. The Weathered Expanse remains the busiest field of all: forty-nine actions, four posts Colonial, three Warden, two in ruins, with Wightwalk and Crow's Nest again the storm-centers. Stlican Shelf's casualty rates climb steeply, Briar the focal point, eight posts to one. Mooring County's churn at The Wind Hills has eased, and Palantine Berm has been silent since midday. It is day 505; thirty-four victory towns will decide this war, and neither banner yet claims one.
